mode.title: Mode
mode.description: search = companies matching a country, industry or founding window. company = full profile for the names you give. subsidiaries = what a parent company owns.

country.title: Country
country.description: Search mode. Plain English name such as Germany, Japan or Brazil. Leave empty to search every country.

industry.title: Industry (optional)
industry.description: Search mode. A plain term such as software, banking, pharmaceutical or automotive.

foundedFrom.title: Founded from (optional)
foundedFrom.description: Search mode. Earliest founding year, e.g. 2015 to find newer companies. 0 for no limit.

foundedTo.title: Founded to (optional)
foundedTo.description: Search mode. Latest founding year. 0 for no limit.

listedOnly.title: Only listed companies
listedOnly.description: Search mode. Keep only companies that trade on a stock exchange.

companies.title: Companies (company mode)
companies.description: Names or entity ids, e.g. Siemens, Toyota, Q95. Full legal names resolve more reliably than short brand names.

parentCompany.title: Parent company (subsidiaries mode)
parentCompany.description: The group whose holdings you want, e.g. Alphabet Inc. or Nestle.

maxResults.title: Max companies per run
maxResults.description: Cap on companies returned. Large uncapped searches are also more likely to time out at the source.
